official.deadline_note: Candidates who submit a completed application before 15 January are considered for all funding opportunities; those who apply after that date are considered only for any remaining available funding.
official.status_note: The admissions page states '2027-2028 applications are open!' and publishes an application deadline of January 15, 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Waivers covering 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of tuition fees, plus a limited number of fully-funded scholarships (100% of fees and some additional stipend, depending on the scholarship).
benefits: Tuition-fee waivers covering 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of tuition fees
A limited number of fully-funded scholarships (100% of fees and some additional stipend, depending on the scholarship)
Fundacion Ramon Areces scholarships covering 100% of tuition for students in the Economics Program or Finance Program; all applicants to the eligible programs are considered
One UniCredit Foundation Masterscholarship for study in the Economics Program or Finance Program; all applicants to the eligible programs are considered
Full or partial tuition waivers provided by sponsors Aena, Banco Sabadell and Repsol Fundacion, open to applicants to all Master's programs
An average of EUR 550,000 in merit-based funding awarded to Master's students each year, with around 24% of matriculated students receiving full or partial funding
A 20% tuition discount on a second BSE Master's program for all BSE alumni
eligibility: Applicant to a BSE Master's program
Only applicants with outstanding academic records will receive a financial offer
For the named full scholarships: applicant to the Economics Program or Finance Program (Fundacion Ramon Areces and UniCredit Foundation)
requirements: Create an account in the BSE Application System at apply.bse.eu
Complete the application questions, including personal data, education, exam grades, English language level, work experience, finance and scholarship details, and the contact details of two referees
Upload all required documents before submitting
Both referees must upload their signed letters directly; the application is not considered complete until both letters have been uploaded
Pay the EUR 100 application fee by credit card or Flywire; the fee is non-refundable
documents: Undergraduate academic transcripts or mark sheets (official final transcript, or provisional transcript plus a signed declaration that the degree will be obtained before the program starts)
Copy of the undergraduate diploma or certification/proof of degree completion
Proof of English level (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or Cambridge)
Two reference letters uploaded directly by the referees, on official letterhead and signed, including the referee's full name, work address and email
GRE score, only for applicants to the PhD Track Program
Sworn translation of the diploma or transcript if it is not in English, Spanish, Catalan, French, Italian or Portuguese
selection_criteria: Fulfilment of the application requirements does not guarantee admission
First-round applicants are considered for all funding opportunities; later applicants only for remaining funds
coverage: Tuition fees (partial or full waiver, 25% to 100%)
Tuition fees for 2027-28 are EUR 20,000 for the Data Science programs and EUR 18,500 for all other programs, and they do not cover housing or living expenses
application_method: Create an account in the BSE Application System and choose a password
Complete the application questions (up to 3 programs may be selected)
Pay the application fee and submit
Financial aid (tuition fee waivers) is granted at the time of admissions and the financial aid offer is delivered together with the offer of admission
official.application_route: Online through the BSE Application System at apply.bse.eu; there is no separate scholarship application, as all candidates are considered for tuition fee waivers on the basis of academic merit.
official.international_eligibility: No citizenship or residency restriction is published on the admissions page; the application form collects citizenship only for contact purposes.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The Fundacion Ramon Areces and UniCredit Foundation scholarships are restricted to the Economics Program or Finance Program. Sponsor tuition waivers from Aena, Banco Sabadell and Repsol Fundacion are open to applicants to all Master's programs. A GRE score is required only for the PhD Track Program.
official.research_requirement: A GRE score is required only for applicants to the PhD Track Program; a Statement of Purpose is required from all applicants and must explain their recent mathematical background.
official.duration: One Master's program cycle; the financial aid offer is issued together with the offer of admission.
official.description: The Barcelona School of Economics offers funding to attract the most talented students: the most talented admitted candidates receive a financial offer that covers all or part of their tuition fees, drawn from public and private sponsors and from BSE's own resources. There is no separate application for financial aid - all candidates are considered for tuition fee waivers, which are awarded on the basis of academic merit.
official.program_type: Merit-based tuition-fee waivers and named full scholarships for BSE Master's students
official.english_requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL 90, Duolingo English Test minimum 120, or Cambridge Exams (Proficiency or Advanced) 176 minimum score, B2-C2. Proof is not required for native English speakers or for applicants who completed their undergraduate degree at an English-speaking university.

applicant_utility.summary: BSE runs a single admissions application that doubles as your funding application: there is no separate scholarship form, and the tuition-waiver decision arrives in the same email as your admission offer. Your realistic prize is a 25/50/75/100% tuition waiver, with the 100% plus stipend awards reserved for a small number of Economics or Finance applicants. File before 15 January 2027 if you want to be in the running for every pot, because late applications are only assessed against whatever money is left. Budget for Barcelona living costs yourself - BSE states plainly that its fees do not cover housing or living expenses.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants with a strong quantitative record and a tight, maths-heavy Statement of Purpose who can file a complete application before the 15 January funding cut-off.
application_readiness_checklist: Contact both referees before you start the form, and warn them that BSE emails them directly after you submit - the file stays incomplete until both letters are uploaded
Ask referees to write on institutional letterhead, signed, with their full name, work address and email, and to name you in the body of the letter
Draft the Statement of Purpose early and dedicate a section to your mathematical background (courses, research or applied work) - the page calls this essential
Book an English test in time: TOEFL 90, IELTS Academic 6.5, Duolingo 120 or Cambridge 176 (B2-C2)
Trim the CV to two pages maximum and gather transcripts, diploma copy and passport scan before opening the portal
Set aside the EUR 100 non-refundable application fee (credit card or Flywire) and check whether your diploma or transcript needs a sworn translation
common_rejection_risks: Submitting with only one referee letter uploaded - BSE treats the application as incomplete, so you are out of the funding round entirely
Applying after 15 January, which silently removes you from most funding pots even though admissions stay open
A thin Statement of Purpose on the quantitative side; a high GPA alone does not carry an application that cannot show maths training
Waiting for an English certificate you do not yet hold - BSE explicitly suggests deferring your application until you can meet the requirement
Applying to the PhD Track without a GRE score, which is the one place where that test is mandatory
Non-English/Spanish/Catalan/French/Italian/Portuguese transcripts submitted without a sworn translation
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Housing and living expenses in Barcelona are explicitly outside the fee, plus the EUR 100 non-refundable application fee and any test or sworn-translation costs.
document_audit: The CV is capped at two pages - longer submissions invite avoidable scepticism
Reference letters must come from the referees themselves through the portal, so a letter you upload yourself does not count
If your degree is unfinished, the signed declaration of expected degree replaces the diploma, and the provisional transcript replaces the final one
Choose up to three programs on one application form, so decide the ranking before you start rather than editing later
alerts: 15 January 2027 is the funding cut-off, not the admissions deadline - missing it does not close the door on admission, only on most of the money
Tuition is payable in four instalments, the first due 30 days after the offer, with three more in May, July and September
Tuition is refundable only if you cancel within 14 days of accepting the offer, counted from the earlier of paying the reservation fee or signing the Reply Form
BSE alumni get a 20% discount on a second Master's, which matters if you are weighing two sequential BSE programs
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on apply.bse.eu, fill the single form (up to 3 programs, finance and scholarship section included), upload documents, pay EUR 100, submit; referees then upload their letters and the admissions decision with any financial offer follows by email.
